user_constraint: Only model-assisted diagnosis currently available; human-reviewed gold labels unavailable.
interpretation: Model-assisted exploratory use can proceed with disclosed uncertainty; this is not human-validated accuracy. Historical time evidence is a separate gate.

modules.scope: USA Records, complete calendar quarters through 2026Q2
modules.use: descriptive observed-ad counts with coverage controls

modules.scope: official 2019 members; missing and nonmembers retained in denominators
modules.not: classification accuracy or contemporaneous coding proof
cooccurrence proves binding or actual adoption

model_evaluation_rules: Fix calibration/test split and evaluation contract before scoring; no sealed-test text or labels during development.
Report model identities, blinded information, model disagreements, adjudication rules, unresolved cases and evidence-span checks.
Separate precision/recall versus model reference from human accuracy; model agreement may share systematic error.
Report false positives, false negatives, strength errors, numeric/object-binding errors by cohort/source and support counts.
Do not infer zero error from no disagreements or zero parse failures.
No fixed sample count or threshold alone establishes comparability; assess period-specific measurement sensitivity before substantive trend interpretation.
